findings.why_it_matters: The statement heading is one level too deep: its siblings 6.5 ACCEPT, 6.6 ADD, 6.8 COMPUTE, 6.9 CONTINUE and 6.10 DISPLAY are '##' headings with '###' subclauses, while 6.7 is '###' and its subclauses 6.7.1-6.7.4 are '####', so a heading-based section index nests ALTER under the ADD statement.
